name: safectx
description: Create local AI-safe copies before confidential files enter a model context.

interface.shortDescription: Sanitize files locally before sharing them with AI.
interface.longDescription: SafeContext creates deterministic copies under .ai-safe, reports risk categories without printing detected values, and tells Codex to use only the sanitized copies for downstream work.
defaultPrompt: Make an AI-safe copy of these files before reading them.
Scan this workspace for secrets and create sanitized copies.
